#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    BufferedReader reader;
    StringTokenizer tokenizer;
    
    InputReader(InputStream stream) {
        reader = BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
        tokenizer = null;
    }
    
    String next() {
        while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

class Unstoppable {
public:
    void solve(InputReader& in, PrintWriter& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        long long b = in.nextLong();
        vector<int> a(n), c(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) c[i] = 1;
            else c[i] = -1;
        }
        long long sum = 0;
        vector<int> arr;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            sum += c[i];
            if (sum == 0) {
                arr.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i+1]));
            }
        }
        sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)arr.size(); i++) {
            sum += arr[i];
            if (sum <= b) count++;
            else break;
        }
        out << count << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(cin);
    cout << fixed;
    PrintWriter out(cout);
    Unstoppable solver;
    solver.solve(in, out);
    return 0;
}
